review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: The increasing prevalence of commercial in the perspective this tendency brings arguments supported people advertisements believe that advertising can have certain positive impacts, others also are that advertising brings disadvantages in the social disadvantages. In my opinion, there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Some people support advocate argue for advertisement think that advertising can bring undeniable economic benefits. Advertisements have creative content and appealing visual effects, so it is stimulate consumer demand. They require their spending power and it helps to increase production, encourage leading to more employment opportunities and greater state revenues through taxation. This contribute to a stronger economy. For example, having e-commerce platforms such as Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam, which rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Additionally, advertising also creates jobs in marketing, media and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

On the other hand, people also cite that advertising has negative social consequences. The chief among these is that in today digital age companies constantly show images of perfect lifestyle or luxury standards and from that drive consumer interest. For instance, young people feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok, thereby this can lead to frustration when they cannot afford them. Another flaw is that advertising can promote materialistic values, which can affect young generations awareness and be a money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, I am firmly convinced that both views are valid to some certain extent. Advertising may can contribute to social dissatisfaction, but it play a crucial role in economic development.

paragraphs: The increasing prevalence of advertising has prompted debate. Some people believe that it brings economic benefits, whereas others argue that it can cause social disadvantages. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Advertisements with creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand. This increases spending power, encourages production, and leads to more employment opportunities and greater state revenues through taxation. This contributes to a stronger economy. For example, e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting both their sales and the digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media, and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. In the digital age, companies constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards, and luxury possessions, fostering dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok, leading to frustration when they cannot afford them. In the long run, advertising can promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture.
In conclusion, I believe both views are valid to a certain extent. Advertising may contribute to social dissatisfaction while playing a crucial role in economic development.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

paragraphs: Nowaday, individuals are being too much affected by the news media, which leading to a negative development. Personally, I am of the same former school of thought and the opposite latter school of thought.

Admittedly, I believe that there are many news media appear everyday which have to much influence on people's lives. fristly, the widespread access to smartphones and the internet which allow people to follow the new instantly while wherever and whenever they are. It naturally follows that the news becomes to a regular part of their routine. Secondly, the intense competition among new outlets in order to gain attention, thereby most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content to present it in a highly sensationalized manner with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals which reinforces the overall impacts of news on public opinion.

The news media have negative influence on people's lives and it also bring advantages. Individuals exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news, they can overwhelm, which lead them to feel anxious and helpless even in situations that do not directly affect them. Nevertheless, the news coverage can warn the public to existing and looing problems in society, say, crime, natural disaster or political corruption. Therefore, individual can better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats to handle risks in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that people's lives were affected by the news media and it has a both good news and bad news.

The news media have too much influence on people’s lives today and this is a negative development.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that students who have the best academic results should be rewarded by school. Many others hold a reserve opinion, believing that improvement students also should be praised by school. Personally, there are strong cases to be made for both students, the best students and improvement students.

Admittedly, students who show the best academic results should be rewarded. This is predicated initially on the assumption that students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, so they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards to propel towards overall academic gains. In addition, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. It naturally follows that students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition which can may enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, I strongly believe that school also should reward students who show improvements. If only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, this can cause others to think that their effort is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding their individuals. As a result, they have prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Moreover, emphasizing improvements, school should encourage all students to be diligent in their studies, which help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves even benefits themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that both views are valid to a certain extent. School should reward for both the best students and students have improvements in academic results.

review.overall: Em trình bày đủ hai quan điểm, giữ lập trường thưởng cả học sinh đứng đầu lẫn học sinh tiến bộ và triển khai được cả bốn chuỗi ý chính. Điểm tốt là Body 1 nối nỗ lực học tập với phần thưởng và Body 2 nêu rõ hệ quả nản chí khi chỉ số ít được thưởng. Tuy nhiên, những câu dài còn ghép sai chủ ngữ và động từ: “which can may enable”, “they have prone” và “school should reward for both” làm phần diễn đạt thiếu chắc chắn. Bài cần sửa và tự soát từng mệnh đề, nhất là câu mở, câu nối hệ quả và câu kết. Body 1 đã dùng “initially” cho lý do công sức và “In addition” cho lý do cạnh tranh. paragraphs: It is argued that students who have the best academic results should be rewarded by schools. Others hold a different opinion, believing that students who make progress should also be praised by schools. Personally, there are strong cases to be made for rewarding both high-achieving students and students who make progress.

Supporters of rewarding high-achieving students argue that those with the best academic results should be rewarded. This is predicated initially on the assumption that students who have diligently applied themselves to their studies deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win rewards, thereby promoting overall academic gains. In addition, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. As students encounter such competition, they may become used to it and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which may enable them to achieve success in later life.

Advocates of rewarding progress argue that schools should also reward students who show improvements. The key reason is that if only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, this can cause others to think that their effort is futile. This is because they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, they are prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Moreover, rewarding improvement can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help them understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves may benefit them more than the determination to defeat others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that both views are valid to a certain extent. Schools should reward both the best students and those who have made progress in their studies.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
